raw_segments.text: But it was not her business to think for me, or to seek a place for me.
Besides, in her eyes, how doubtful must have appeared my character, position, tale.
She was sorry she could give me no information.
And the white door closed, quite gently and civilly.
If she had held it open a little longer, I believe I should have begged a piece of bread,
for I was now brought low.
